subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should this PR introduce `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin API, or should plugin app-nav/page launches be folded into the existing `registerControlUiDescriptor({ surface: "tab", path })` contract on current main?
rationale: Both paths would let plugins add Control UI navigation backed by plugin routes, but choosing the permanent public SDK and gateway shape affects third-party plugin compatibility and cannot be safely decided by an automated repair.

options.title: Fold into the existing descriptor contract
options.body: Extend the current tab descriptor projection with the launch-token and open-mode behavior that maintainers want, avoiding a parallel plugin UI API.

options.title: Approve the new entry-point API
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint` only with explicit maintainer API-shape approval and clear docs explaining why the existing tab descriptor is insufficient.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: If the current main descriptor tab surface is sufficient, keep the narrower existing contract and close this PR without adding another public seam.

recommendation.title: Fold into the existing descriptor contract
recommendation.body: Extend the current tab descriptor projection with the launch-token and open-mode behavior that maintainers want, avoiding a parallel plugin UI API.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current plugin Control UI tab seam and has the strongest recent gateway/security ownership signal for this API decision.
